title: Record a length-2 return witness for every positive length-22 split
body:
## Summary
- A one-bit prefix step flips weight parity, so every return has even length.
- Each of the ten admitted length-22 splits with a positive revisit count has an explicit restored witness. The distances between equal prefix states are exactly 2, 20 and 22.
- Partial, no new kappa. The witnesses are not a word census and do not claim f(7).

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/revisit-length-witness/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/revisit-length-witness/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/revisit-length-witness`
